package.name: @vmitsaras/raveldex
package.description: Native modular TypeScript local search — ESM core with BM25, atomic mutations, cooperative execution, optional search capabilities and native DOM UI.

scripts.check: npm run handoff:check && npm run docs:check && npm run typecheck && npm test
scripts.test: npm run build && node --test --test-concurrency=4 --test-timeout=180000 test/tooling/*.test.mjs test/core/*.test.mjs test/consumer/*.test.mjs test/addons/phrases/*.test.mjs test/addons/positions/*.test.mjs test/addons/filters/*.test.mjs test/addons/facets/*.test.mjs test/addons/inspector/*.test.mjs test/addons/evidence/*.test.mjs test/adapters/snapshots/*.test.mjs test/migration/converter.test.mjs test/comparison/*.test.mjs && node --test --test-timeout=120000 test/ui/*.test.mjs && node --test --test-timeout=120000 test/adapters/worker/*.test.mjs && node --test --test-timeout=120000 test/adapters/indexeddb/*.test.mjs && node --test --test-timeout=120000 test/migration/packed-browser.test.mjs
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p tsconfig.json && tsc -p test/types/tsconfig.json && tsc -p tsconfig.ui.json && tsc -p tsconfig.worker.json && tsc -p tsconfig.indexeddb.json && tsc -p tsconfig.migration.json
scripts.build: node scripts/clean-build.mjs && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && tsc -p tsconfig.ui.build.json && node scripts/copy-ui-css.mjs && tsc -p tsconfig.worker.build.json && tsc -p tsconfig.indexeddb.build.json && tsc -p tsconfig.migration.build.json && node scripts/copy-migration-license.mjs
scripts.test:migration: npm run build && node --test --test-timeout=120000 test/migration/converter.test.mjs test/comparison/*.test.mjs && node --test --test-timeout=120000 test/migration/packed-browser.test.mjs

method.process: One fresh Node main-isolate process for each configuration/size/repetition; never concurrent. Relevant imports and harness precede baseline. Fresh module process, not an uninstrumented latency benchmark.
method.collection: Three setImmediate → explicit global.gc() → 25ms settling cycles for every steady stage; all three raw readings retained. Fixtures released before built observations; encoder string then handles separately released.
method.during: process.memoryUsage() and V8 readings before/after public operation, first observed native phase per operation and every8192 emitted native generator steps through observation-only installed-private seam. Sample maximum is a lower bound on transient peak, not guaranteed true peak; native synchronous segments and between-sample allocations may escape observation.
method.graphs: Separate fresh intrusive processes only, first repetition per configuration/size. V8 synchronous main-isolate heap dumps at built, mutation precommit and export-string held. Dumps not mixed into primary sample pass. Dump hashes/schema and selected-edge reachable self-size component summaries retained; full local dumps remain in temporary directory.
method.attribution: Measured whole-process/V8 observations and selected-data graph attribution. No process subtraction is relabeled isolated component retained size; no serialized bytes/object counts are relabeled heap. Strong dominators, hidden/map/code overhead and browser worker/transport memory remain unqualified.
method.fixture: Same admitted synthetic ASCII fixture as RX4001; 1000/10000 records, batch256, deadline60000, unchanged defensive/resource limits.
method.childEnvironment: Only PATH, TMPDIR, LANG, LC_ALL inherited; no application credentials or unrelated environment included in heap dumps.
method.kernelHighWater: macOS /usr/bin/time -l wraps each fresh child; maximum resident set size is the complete child process lifetime kernel high-water in bytes, including all harness/import/GC/instrumentation and operation stages. Separate graph-process high-water includes intrusive dump allocation. Never assigned to an individual component or operation.

limitations: These are instrumented Node main-isolate/process observations, not browser memory qualification.
Reachable selected-data self-size excludes prototype/map/code/weak/hidden edges and is not dominant retained size; shared subgraphs are reported once in union and separately rather than added twice.
Sampled maximum cannot identify the true allocation high-water mark or assign isolated staging/serialization/transport bytes.
Worker realms, browser renderers, UI and transport copies require separate browser allocation/retainer observations.
Explicit GC and heap dumping alter execution. RSS may retain allocator pages after object release. No noise threshold is invented as a pass condition.
No native snapshot portability, physical latency/paint, heap capacity promise or workload beyond10000 is inferred.
